subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What pre-auth connection diagnostics may the Control UI expose and make copyable without weakening auth, device, endpoint, and privacy boundaries?
rationale: The useful behavior depends on which handshake/auth/device details are safe before a trusted session exists, so automation should not choose the disclosure policy alone.

options.title: Sanitized Client-Only Diagnostics
options.body: Expose only client-side timing phases, close codes, redacted error codes/details, and copy support before auth; keep server log tails post-auth.

options.title: Authenticated Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep pre-auth UI to categorized failure guidance and expose richer gateway logs only after operator.read is available.

options.title: Consent-Based Support Export
options.body: Design a support export that combines redacted client diagnostics with authenticated gateway logs after connection succeeds.

recommendation.title: Sanitized Client-Only Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose only client-side timing phases, close codes, redacted error codes/details, and copy support before auth; keep server log tails post-auth.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on Control UI login-gate and auth-adjacent recovery behavior where steipete has the strongest recent history and verified PR ownership.
